picks.title: Deezer to let users block AI-generated music from search results
picks.excerpt: Deezer is introducing an on/off toggle that lets users exclude fully AI-generated music from search results; with it on, AI-generated tracks, albums and related artists won't appear. Deezer already keeps detected fully-AI tracks out of algorithmic recommendations and editorial playlists.
picks.rationale: A major streaming service is launching a listener-side switch that removes fully AI-generated music from search. That is a new product decision, separate from Qobuz's 09-25 AI tag.

picks.title: Lalu's Corner: Who Controls the Digital Version of You?
picks.excerpt: A column for independent artists on AI voice and likeness control, from Jason Isbell's suit against Suno and the deadmau5 deepfake to the 'I Run' Jorja Smith soundalike, and how UMG, Sony and Warner are taking different routes on licensing, takedowns and opt-in.
picks.rationale: A practical guide for independent artists on controlling their AI voice and likeness. Its cases (Isbell v. Suno, the deadmau5 deepfake, the Jorja Smith soundalike) have not run as cards.

picks.title: Digital Blackface: The Problematic State Of AI Music
picks.excerpt: Producer Louis La Roche examines what he calls digital blackface in AI music, naming the people behind one of the biggest AI-artist operations on streaming services.
picks.rationale: A producer's investigation into who runs a large AI-artist operation on streaming services. It brings a new angle (racialized AI personas) that has not been covered before.
